job.job_title: Data Engineer - Python, Machine Learning,NLP, LLM, ML
job.job_description:
5 TO 8 years of exprience in Python, Machine Learning,NLP, LLM, ML Frameworks,Math & Statistics.FastAPI, Flask,Deep Learning,
and also would be good if they have additonal knowledge of AWS (SageMaker), Google Cloud (Vertex AI),or Azure Machine Learning, MLOps, LLM Ops
Experience working with Claude Code/ Cursor or Copilot
Key duties: Define, evaluate, and iterate our extraction approach, appropriate for each stage of the project.
Significant NLP experience:
Ontologies: How to decide on and structure ontologies to fit a particular purpose
Representations: How information from text can be represented to enable downstream applications
Training and testing process: How to maintain free-text corpora annotated with positive and negative examples, how to create evals for model outputs that fit a particular model performance profile
DS/ML project management experience: taking a project from research to POC to production, with appropriate time-investment decisions for each phase of the project
Consistently focused on discovery and targeting of user needs
Good version control and documentation practices
Ready for agentic engineering practices (see above), including strong familiarity with best-practices Python coding
Familiarity with academic literature a strong bonus
